Spain's weather agency has confirmed that Spaniards have already endured 61 days of heatwave conditions so far this year, more than in any other year.
Spain has surpassed the scorching summer of 2022, with a total of 61 heatwave days endured this year, compared with 41 previously, according to the State Meteorological Agency (Aemet).

The summer of 2026 has also recorded an average temperature of 24.5°C, making it the hottest since records began in 1961 and surpassing last year, 2025, by 0.3°C, and 2.4°C above the long-term average.
Aemet recalls that the 10 hottest summers on record have all occurred in the 21st century, and seven of the eight warmest have taken place since 2015. The agency also warns that the meteorological summer keeps getting longer.
"At the end of May, temperatures typical of July were recorded across large areas of the country. And then, in September, already in the meteorological autumn, there was another heatwave which, provisionally, ran from the 2nd to the 7th, lasting six days and affecting 16 provinces."
September heat, rainfall and wildfires: Spain outlook
Only in four other years has a month of September (1987, 1988, 2006 and 2016) seen such extreme heatwaves, more typical of the height of summer.
The heavy winter rains have meant that Spanish reservoirs have remained in very good condition after the summer season, with an average level of 62.58 per cent despite tourist pressure, and above half of their capacity in basins that are usually under stress, such as the Júcar, Segura, Andalusian Mediterranean and Catalan catchments.
Even so, this has not spared the country from suffering, as in the rest of Europe, large-scale fires that have exposed the lack of forest fire prevention and of sufficient personnel with good working conditions, in regions such as Madrid, Aragón or Castilla y León.

VVV price at all-time high with 60% gain in early September: What’s next?
VVV price hit an all-time high of $29.28 on September 9, 2026, after a 60% rally in September and a 1494% YTD gain, before pulling back 7% on profit booking. Trading volume spiked to $265.631M from just $12M in two days, signaling strong trader engagement.
VVV price has experienced strong buying pressure and has recorded an all-time high of $29.28 on September 09, 2026. The price has slightly dropped after reaching an all-time high. Great changes in trading volume were spotted which showcased the engagement of traders and investors. Lets explore the Venice token price forecast based on the technical analysis.
Venice token (VVV) price overview
At press time, Venice token was trading at $26.02 with an intraday gain of 41.03%. Its market capitalization was $1.247B and the 24-hour trading volume was $265.631M. It has a circulating supply of 47.901M VVV while the total supply is 80.972M VVV.
VVV price technical analysis over 1-D timeframe
Venice token price has been in a bullish trend and has delivered 1494% gain YTD. The price has surged by 60% in September and has recorded an all-time high of $29.28 on September 09, 2026. After recording all-time high, the price has dropped by 7% in just a few hours due to profit booking.
The trading volume has increased to $265.631M from $12M in just 2 days. This great change suggests the traders’ and investors’ engagement is high in this token. This data suggests that the VVV price could continue the bullish trend further.
Amid this bullish trend, the price has surpassed the previous swing high of June. If buyers remain stronger, the VVV price can continue the trend. If the trading volume and open interest remains high, the price could extend to the $50 mark amid this bullish trend.
Conversely, if the price drops below today’s low of $24 then panic selling can be seen. If retailers and holders with small capital prefer to book profit, the price might take a pause before any directional momentum. If profit booking increases then sellers may dominate and VVV price may experience bearish moves.
How is VVV token different from other cryptocurrencies?
Key Differentiators
Privacy by Architecture: Unlike mainstream AI tools that track and store user data, Venice keeps data processing local-first and encrypted to block centralized surveillance.
Stake-for-Service Utility: Instead of paying per-request fees for AI prompts, users can stake VVV tokens to get continuous, free access to AI inference capacity through the platform’s developer API.
Deflationary Buy-and-Burn: The platform uses its commercial revenue to buy VVV tokens from the open market and permanently burn them, decreasing supply as usage grows.
Base Chain Efficiency: Built on Coinbase’s Layer-2 Base Network, it avoids the high gas fees and slow transaction speeds plaguing tokens on legacy networks.
Buy and Burn Program in Venice token
Venice’s token $VVV is showing a strong deflationary trend through its monthly buy-and-burn program, according to data shared by VeniceStats. The platform’s September buy-and-burn round cleared approximately $390,000 worth of $VVV, marking the largest monthly burn in USD terms to date and extending a streak of seven consecutive monthly increases. Notably, the token’s price hit an all-time high of $25.38 just hours after this burn was executed, suggesting a possible correlation between reduced token supply and price appreciation.
Adding to the bullish signal, separate Pro Subscription and credit-based burns have already reached $508,000 in September, with the month only eight days old at the time of posting. The accompanying chart tracks monthly buy-and-burn activity from early 2025 through September 2026, visually confirming a steady, accelerating upward trajectory in burn volumes over recent months, reinforcing the narrative of growing platform usage and token scarcity.
VVV main private inference
NEAR Protocol has highlighted its role in powering Venice AI, a privacy-first AI platform that has surpassed 3 million users. According to NEAR, it provides the infrastructure enabling Venice’s privacy features, spanning private inference to confidential execution. The integration works through encrypted prompts: user queries are encrypted on-device before leaving the computer.
These encrypted requests are then routed through NEAR AI Cloud into Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs), isolated hardware such as Intel TDX or NVIDIA Confidential Computing: where data is decrypted and processed within a sealed environment inaccessible even to Venice’s own operators.
Venice Token OI-Weighted Funding Rate
VVV’s OI-weighted funding rate spiked to an extreme ~0.18% as price surged from around $15 to an all-time high near $29 (Sep 8–9, 2026), signaling the rally was heavily leverage-driven, with long traders paying steep premiums to stay in their positions. Such extreme positive funding often precedes long squeezes, and that’s already visible on the chart — price has pulled back to the $22–27 range as funding cooled to roughly 0.09–0.12%, still elevated but off its peak.
For a price outlook: if funding keeps unwinding while price fails to hold the $20–22 zone, a deeper correction toward $18–20 is likely as overleveraged longs get flushed out. If funding normalizes further and price stabilizes above $22, that would suggest the rally is being absorbed by genuine demand rather than pure leverage, opening the path to retest the $27–29 highs. A key warning sign to flag would be funding staying hot while price stalls that divergence typically signals an overheated market vulnerable to a sharp drop.
Final thoughts
VVV’s 60% September surge and fresh all-time high reflect a token riding strong momentum, but the sharp pullback from the peak is a reminder that parabolic moves often come with equally sharp corrections. The trading volume spike is a genuine bullish signal, it shows real participation behind the rally, not just a thin-volume spike that could reverse quickly.
That said, traders should watch two levels closely: a hold above $24 keeps the bullish structure intact and opens the door toward the $50 target if volume and open interest stay elevated. A break below $24, however, could trigger panic selling and drag the price into a consolidation phase, or worse, a deeper correction as short-term holders lock in profits.

VVV hit an all-time high of $29.28 on September 9, 2026, before pulling back about 7% due to profit booking, trading around $26.02 at press time.
Why is VVV price rising so sharply in September 2026?
The rally is driven by a combination of factors: a record monthly buy-and-burn of ~$390,000 that reduced token supply, a massive trading volume surge (from $12M to $265.631M in two days), and heavy leverage from traders, as reflected in the spiked OI-weighted funding rate.

full_text:
Bhubaneswar: A fresh low-pressure area is likely to form over the Bay of Bengal Thursday, bringing heavy rain to several parts of Odisha over the next three days, the IMD said.
The state experienced light to moderate rain at several places Wednesday.
In its evening bulletin, the IMD said, A Low Pressure Area is anticipated to take shape across the North Bay of Bengal and surrounding regions September 10, 2026.
The weather office has issued red, orange and yellow warnings for different districts till September 14, indicating extremely heavy rainfall of more than 20 cm, heavy rainfall of 12-20 cm and 7-11 cm, respectively.
For the next 24 hours, a red warning for extremely heavy rainfall of more than 20 cm has been issued for Mayurbhanj district.
An orange warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall has been issued for Baleshwar, Bhadrak and Keonjhar districts Thursday.
Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty surface winds, with speeds reaching 40-50 kmph, are also very likely at one or two places in Baleshwar, Bhadrak, Keonjhar and Mayurbhanj districts, the IMD said.
A yellow warning for heavy rainfall has been issued for Jajpur, Kendrapada, Jagatsinghpur, Cuttack, Anugola, Dhenkanal, Kalahandi, Rayagada, Koraput, Gajapati, Ganjam, Puri and Khordha districts.
The IMD said squally weather, with winds reaching 40-50 kmph and gusting to 60 kmph, is likely along and off the Odisha coast till September 11.
